name: Canonical Radiance Field with Voxel Grid
definition: A representation of a static scene at canonical time using a learnable voxel radiance feature grid and a lightweight MLP, replacing the heavy MLP in NeRF to allow querying finite 3D points.
summary: Canonical Radiance Field with Voxel Grid replaces NeRF's MLP with discrete voxel grids for faster, memory-efficient static scene representation, differing from explicit fields by separating density and color features.
